elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added language applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly available “for up to 6 months.”

elements.evidence: The return is required “within 30 days after expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires a “standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After the return obligation, subsection (c) requires Vendor to “thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion after the Customer Data is deleted.
elements.evidence: Vendor must “certify such deletion in writing” after the return and deletion steps.

result.reason: The added operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It leaves the original payment, delivery, and refund terms intact and adds only targeted transition, data-return, deletion, and certification duties. The request condition reasonably operationalizes Customer's right to obtain assistance rather than negating it.
